narrative_purpose: Sets the convergent shape against the divergent build directly: same pouncing pose, one Earth cat and one Pandoran predator, so the reader sees role-convergence and body-divergence at once.
subject: A clean two-panel comparison, a faint vertical seam dividing the frame. LEFT panel: an Earth black panther mid-pounce, four limbs, two eyes, sleek and feline, springing forward. RIGHT panel: a Pandoran thanator in the identical explosive pouncing pose so the silhouettes echo, but with six limbs, an armoured swept-back crest, four eyes in two stacked pairs, and lateral breathing membranes along its flank. The two poses mirror each other across the seam.
scene: Both animals against a simple dim bioluminescent-forest backdrop kept plain so the bodies dominate.
camera: Matched side-on views, both animals at the same scale and pose for direct comparison.
light: Even cool rim light on both bodies from glowing flora; backgrounds dark and uncluttered.
palette: Cool teal-indigo throughout, the panther in slightly warmer neutral shadow, the thanator in cooler teal, scarce magenta glints in the alien eyes.
style: Two matched naturalist plates, painterly, reading as a comparison through composition alone.
detail_level: High on both animals' silhouettes; minimal background.
composition: Symmetric left/right panels mirroring the same pose, plain dark space above each animal for callouts.
consistency_notes: The thanator must match fig-00/fig-01. The panther is a real Earth black panther for contrast.
